# HLMC'S Enterprise & Services, Inc. (H&SI)

> Philippine SEC-registered sourcing and supply house (registered June 15, 2023) for commodities, construction materials, medical supplies, heavy equipment and real estate — in partnership with APSA UK LTD, London (est. 2014).

## What the site offers
- Home: company story, vision and mission, core values, permits and credentials
- Product lines: Thailand/Vietnam rice, cement, sugar, diesel, construction materials, steel and rebars, aggregates, medical supplies and equipment, essential supplies, heavy equipment and container vans, construction services
- Real estate: the Wimbledon Hills collection (Clarence House, Syon House, Marble House) by Kimjao APSA HESI, plus property services
- Inquiry Center: product inquiries, new-product sourcing requests, order inquiries and tracking, requests for quotation (RFQ), outsourcing/best-price inquiries and general questions
- My Inquiries: customers track inquiry and order status with a reference number

## Key pages
- / — full corporate site
- /inquire — Inquiry Center (7 categories)
- /track — My Inquiries status tracker
